messageValues.message: You are an intent classifier for a dental/medical clinic's patient reactivation chatbot. Your only job is to read a patient's WhatsApp reply and classify it into exactly one of these five intents:  - interested: patient wants to book an appointment or is asking about availability - not_interested: patient explicitly declines, says no, or doesn't want to book - question: patient is asking something specific (pricing, location, medical question, etc.) before deciding - human_request: patient wants to talk to a real person/staff, or the message is complex/unclear - stop: patient wants to stop receiving messages (e.g., "stop", "unsubscribe", "don't message me")  Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format, nothing else: {"intent": "one_of_the_five_above", "reason": "brief one-line explanation"}

messageValues.message: You are a friendly, helpful assistant for a dental/medical clinic, chatting with a patient on WhatsApp who hasn't visited in a while. Your goal is to have a natural conversation, answer their questions, and gently guide them toward booking an appointment — without being pushy.  Keep replies short (2-3 sentences max, WhatsApp style). Be warm and professional. If they ask about services, pricing, or timing, answer helpfully based on general clinic knowledge. If they seem ready to book, encourage them to confirm a day/time. Do not make up specific prices or exact availability — keep it general and offer to check for them.

parameters.content:
📌 SW-01 / SW-02: Outreach

Roz 9 AM ko chalta hai. 60+ din se inactive patients (jo opt-out nahi hain) Supabase se nikalta hai, har ek ko WhatsApp template message bhejta hai, naya conversation record banata hai, aur sab kuch (message + event) Supabase mein log karta hai.

Patient jab bhi WhatsApp pe reply kare, ye chalta hai. Patient ko dhoondta hai, purani conversation link karta hai, LLM se reply ka intent samajhta hai, aur 5 tarah se handle karta hai:

Interested → available slots offer karta hai → number select karne pe Google Calendar mein booking confirm karta hai
Not Interested → politely close kar deta hai, reason log karta hai
Question → natural conversation karta hai (LLM, purani history ke sath)
Human Request → Slack pe staff ko alert karta hai, patient ko bhi bata deta hai
Stop → turant opt-out kar deta hai, dobara kabhi message nahi jata

📌 SW-06: Follow-Up Sequencer

Roz chalta hai (alag time pe). Un patients ko dhoondta hai jinhone outreach ke baad reply nahi diya — Day 3, Day 7, aur Day 14 pe dobara nudge bhejta hai (max 3 baar), phir rukk jata hai.

SELECT 
  c.conversation_id, 
  p.name, 
  p.phone, 
  c.status, 
  c.last_message_at,
  c.ai_enabled,
  (SELECT content FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_message_preview
FROM conversations c
JOIN patients p ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC;

SELECT message_id, direction, sender, content, created_at
FROM messages
WHERE conversation_id = '{{ $json.query.conversation_id }}'
ORDER BY created_at ASC;

SELECT p.patient_id, p.phone
FROM conversations c
JOIN patients p ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE c.conversation_id = '{{ $json.body.conversation_id }}';

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, patient_id, direction, sender, content)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('SW-12: Staff Reply Webhook').item.json.body.conversation_id }}',
  '{{ $('SW-12: Get Patient Phone').item.json.patient_id }}',
  'outbound',
  'staff',
  '{{ $('SW-12: Staff Reply Webhook').item.json.body.message.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);

SELECT 
  p.patient_id,
  p.name,
  p.phone,
  p.service_type,
  p.last_appointment_date,
  p.opted_out,
  c.status as conversation_status,
  c.follow_up_count,
  c.ai_enabled,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.patient_id = p.patient_id AND e.event_type = 'booked') as times_booked,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.patient_id = p.patient_id AND e.event_type = 'message_sent') as total_messages_sent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.patient_id = p.patient_id AND e.event_type = 'follow_up_sent') as follow_ups_sent
FROM patients p
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC;

VALUES (

  'outbound',
  'bot',

parameters.content:
📌 SW-10: Get Contacts

Dashboard ke Conversations tab ke liye contact list load karta hai — saare patients + unka last message preview + status + AI on/off status, sab ek sath

📌 SW-11: Get Messages

Kisi ek specific patient ki poori chat history laata hai jab staff us par click kare — sab messages chronological order mein.

📌 SW-12: Staff Manual Reply

Staff dashboard se khud koi message type kare to ye chalta hai — WhatsApp pe bhejta hai, Supabase mein sender = staff ke sath log karta hai, aur conversation ka status staff_handling kar deta hai.

📌 SW-13: Update Conversation Status

Staff manually kisi conversation ka status change kar sake (jaise "closed" mark karna) bina koi message bheje.

📌 SW-15: Get Patients (Database)

Dashboard ke Patient Database tab ke liye — har patient ka pura profile deta hai: naam, phone, last visit, follow-ups count, kitni baar booking hui, AI status, opted-out hai ya nahi.

📌 SW-14: Toggle AI

Dashboard ke AI/Human toggle button ke liye — jab staff manually AI ko ON ya OFF karta hai, ye conversations.ai_enabled ko update kar deta hai.
